title: Recursive Tower of Hanoi using 4 pegs / rods

function.name: towerOfHanoi4Pegs
function.note: Moves from rod A to rod D (aux B, C) using GfG's scheme: move n-2 disks to B, then n-1 via C, n to D, n-1 to D, then n-2 from B to D; each line 'Move disk k from rod X to rod Y'.

example.expected: [Move disk 1 from rod A to rod B, Move disk 2 from rod A to rod C, Move disk 3 from rod A to rod D, Move disk 2 from rod C to rod D, Move disk 1 from rod B to rod D]
